program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((zeros (find-color g 0))
                  (zcols (sort (unique (map snd zeros)) <)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc p)
                       (let ((rank (+ 1 (count-if (lambda (c) (< c (snd p))) zcols))))
                         (set-cell acc (fst p) (snd p) rank)))
                     g
                     zeros)))))
